additional_concerns: Preserving the existing application process does not expressly establish a permanent substantive disqualification for the underlying change. The legacy exclusions in nodes 1bf6918f, 4e6a162c, ce439b1c and ea4d1963 therefore require clarification. Node 4d548f2e instead excludes these cases from its question's scope and supplies no answer for them.

The source specifies commencement on 28 November 2025 but does not identify a universal assessment or implementation event governing every transitional case. The introductory immediate-effect wording should be read with the specific commencement provision; further timing rules require the relevant FAQs or SFC clarification.
The supplied external dependency IDs have no descriptive mapping and both have null source_hash values. Neither can safely be identified as the relevant FAQ or forms dependency.

Applicable home-jurisdiction law and authoritative guidance on novel features, complex features and local policy implications are not supplied. The formulas accept these classifications as inputs; they do not establish their legal accuracy.

The introductory reference to home-regulator supervision states the measures' purpose. Item (ii) expressly uses home-jurisdiction compliance; importing item (i)'s separate supervision condition would add an unsupported restriction.

Removal of prior approval does not establish satisfaction of notification, filing or post-vetting obligations. Conversely, failure of the removal predicate does not establish the complete underlying approval duty.
